# nanopb runtime

Unmodified runtime files from https://github.com/nanopb/nanopb at tag `0.4.9.1`
(zlib licence, see LICENSE.txt). The generated `*.pb.c`/`*.pb.h` for
`proto/link.proto` live in `src/proto/` and are made by `tools/gen_proto.sh`
with the matching generator (`pip install nanopb==0.4.9.1`).
